terms.definition: Force normal to a surface ÷ area of that surface: p = F / A.

terms.examiner: Separate Physics. Fluid pressure acts at right angles to any surface.

terms.definition: Increases with depth and density: p = h ρ g.
The resultant upward force on an object submerged in a fluid, because pressure is greater at the bottom than at the top.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics, higher tier. An object floats if its weight equals the upthrust.

terms.definition: Caused by air molecules colliding with surfaces; it decreases with height because there is less air above.
